import sys

class MinCostMaxFlow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.input = sys.stdin.read().split()
        self.index = 0

    def next(self):
        val = self.input[self.index]
        self.index += 1
        return val

    def nextInt(self):
        return int(self.next())

    def main(self):
        letters = ord('z') - ord('a') + 1
        n = self.nextInt()
        s = self.next()
        string = list(s)
        letCount = [0] * letters
        for i in range(n):
            letCount[ord(string[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
        b = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            b[i] = self.nextInt()

        source = 0
        charOffSet = 1
        pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters
        sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n // 2
        sink = sinkOffSet
        vNum = sinkOffSet + 1

        g = Graph(vNum, source, sink)

        for i in range(letters):
            g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0)
            for j in range(n // 2):
                c1 = string[j]
                c2 = string[n - j - 1]
                if ord(c1) == ord('a') + i:
                    if c1 == c2:
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]))
                    else:
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j])
                else:
                    if c2 == chr(ord('a') + i):
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1])
                    else:
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0)

        for i in range(n // 2):
            g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0)

        ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow()
        print(-ans[1])

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vNum, src, sink):
        self.vNum = vNum
        self.src = src
        self.sink = sink
        self.res = [[0] * vNum for _ in range(vNum)]
        self.cost = [[0] * vNum for _ in range(vNum)]
        self.costGraph = []
        self.d = [0] * vNum
        self.p = [-1] * vNum

    def addEdge(self, from_, to, capacity, cost):
        self.res[from_][to] += capacity
        self.cost[from_][to] = cost
        self.cost[to][from_] = -cost

    def findCheapestPath(self):
        self.costGraph.clear()
        for i in range(self.vNum):
            for j in range(self.vNum):
                if self.res[i][j] > 0:
                    self.costGraph.append(Edge(i, j, self.cost[i][j]))

        for i in range(self.vNum):
            self.d[i] = float('inf')
            self.p[i] = -1
        self.d[self.src] = 0

        for _ in range(self.vNum - 1):
            changed = False
            for e in self.costGraph:
                if self.d[e.from_] != float('inf') and self.d[e.from_] + e.cost < self.d[e.to]:
                    self.d[e.to] = self.d[e.from_] + e.cost
                    self.p[e.to] = e.from_
                    changed = True
            if not changed:
                break
        return self.p[self.sink] != -1

    def augmentPath(self, from_, to, flow):
        pathCost = 0
        for cur in range(to, from_, -1):
            flow = min(flow, self.res[self.p[cur]][cur])
        cur = to
        while cur != from_:
            self.res[self.p[cur]][cur] -= flow
            self.res[cur][self.p[cur]] += flow
            pathCost += self.cost[self.p[cur]][cur] * flow
            cur = self.p[cur]
        return [flow, pathCost]

    def getMinCostMaxFlow(self):
        flow = 0
        totalCost = 0
        while self.findCheapestPath():
            result = self.augmentPath(self.src, self.sink, float('inf'))
            flow += result[0]
            totalCost += result[1]
        return [flow, totalCost]

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, from_, to, cost):
        self.from_ = from_
        self.to = to
        self.cost = cost

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcmf = MinCostMaxFlow()
    mcmf.main()
